tbd_by_probe.item: k rule: telemetry cadence and decision steps
tbd_by_probe.default_r2: physics_steps_per_decision = floor(100 ms / GetFixedTimeSlice() + 0.5), decided first (= 6 at a 60 Hz fixed step); telemetry_every_k = the largest divisor k of physics_steps_per_decision with k x GetFixedTimeSlice() <= 50 ms, at least 1 (= 3 at 60 Hz), so k always divides it; E-10 also logs the WorldTimestamp clock next to GetWorldTime per step

default.rule: N = floor(0.1 / slice + 0.5); k = the largest divisor of N with k * slice <= 0.05 + 1e-6, at least 1

tbd_by_probe.item: image_hz (10 or 5) and the one-request-in-flight rule
tbd_by_probe.default_r2: image_hz = 10 (world-time slot grid phase-locked to the decision steps, img_lead_ms = 0, one MakeScreenshot request in flight, in-flight timeout 2000 ms); fall back to 5 Hz first if E-05 shows misses or request-to-file latency that 10 Hz cannot sustain; at 5 Hz the HL decision rate drops to 5 Hz as well (the decision interval is the training interval, r2 3.5); img_lead_ms is set from the E-05/E-06 capture offsets

tbd_by_probe.item: writer semantics (FileHandle.Write return values, Close durability, taskkill mid-commit)
tbd_by_probe.default_r2: FileHandle.Write returns the number of bytes written (FileHandle.c:93-103; WriteLine returns void and is never used); any return other than the expected byte count is a short or failed write; a closed file survives a process kill; one open-APPEND-write-close cycle per line adds exactly that line (commit.csv and heartbeat.csv; E-19 c11 and the e19kill e19_commit_append.csv log); no file is rewritten in place (E-19 c10 only records whether WRITE truncates)
the request path has no extension (frames/f_<slot_id:08d>) and the engine appends .png, so the file is frames/f_<slot_id:08d>.png (1.8 evidence: a request ending .bmp produced *.bmp.png)

tbd_by_probe.item: steer_sign normalisation (and the yaw-axis and local-axes checks)
tbd_by_probe.default_r2: steer_sign = -1: CarSteering is +1 for left, the contract is right-positive, so steer_contract = steer_sign * steer_engine; yaw_axis_sign = +1 [inference: Enfusion is left-handed with Y up, so +angvel_local_y is clockwise seen from above]; vehicle-local axes x right, y up, z forward; checked by tools/probes/t0eng/e01_actuation.py: steer_sign, yaw_axis_sign and local_axes (z forward: sign of vel_l_z on forward motion; x right: sign of corr(acc_l_x, v x heading rate))

tbd_by_probe.item: launch id visible in Workbench Play
tbd_by_probe.default_r2: System.GetCLIParam("dcLaunchId") returns Workbench's own -dcLaunchId argument in Play mode (launch_guard.launch_mode cli). Answered by DD-4-probe's E-11 console line (-dcLaunchId visible=0 or 1); DD-1's 'Capture output allowed' or 'capture output refused' line tests GetCLIParam("profile") and is only an inference about it. If the id is not visible, Workbench sessions pass through the escape (launch_guard.launch_mode wb_escape, section 5.1); the session.json fields exist either way
affects: launch guard mechanism and launch_guard.launch_mode (no field changes)

tbd_by_probe.default_r2: HasAutomaticGearbox() is true on the S105 and the automatic gearbox works driverless; gear indices map to reverse/neutral/forward through the vehicle card (VehicleCinematicTrack defaults to index 2, so the mapping is read back, never assumed). T0-MIN is forward-only: the card's gear_indices_forward come from E-01 (gear_indices seen while moving forward); gear_index_neutral and gear_index_reverse stay null until a probe phase holds neutral and drives in reverse (an E-01 extension or E-02Q, DD-7-ident); no session commands hl_dir -1 before that
GetGame().GetEngineUserSettings() modules VideoUserSettings and DisplayUserSettings, keys from SCR_SettingsManagerVideoModule.c:12-56

tbd_by_probe.item: road key of the in-engine road dump
tbd_by_probe.default_r2: road_key = <n_pts>/<x0>:<z0>/<x1>:<z1> of the road's GetPoints: n_pts in decimal, the first and last point's x and z each formatted by Enforce float.ToString(-1, 2) (fixed point, 2 decimals), 0 for a road without points (DD-4-probe DC_RoadDump.MakeKey); E-08a dedupes by it and telemetry.road_key writes the same text, so offline matching (E-08b) joins on the logged text and never re-formats coordinates

csv.header: first line of every chunk file; column order is the order of 'fields'; readers parse by header name (C05) and refuse unknown or missing required columns
csv.empty: the empty string is null; allowed only where required is false
csv.decimal: '.'; fixed point, no exponent; >= 3 decimals for m, m/s and m/s2, >= 6 for rad, rad/s, 1/m and unit vectors

writer.write_api: FileHandle.Write with the byte count checked (TBD-3); FileHandle.WriteLine is never used
writer.chunk: a chunk file is written whole (header + rows) by one Write, then closed; it is closed at chunk_max_rows, after chunk_max_s of world time, or at session end, whichever comes first; a chunk is written only when it holds at least one row
writer.commit: after the chunk is closed, one commit line {chunk_id, first_key, last_key, n_rows, n_bytes} is appended to <stream>/commit.csv with one open-APPEND-write-close cycle and checked; only then are the chunk's rows acknowledged
writer.heartbeat: heartbeat.csv: header when the session starts, then one row appended every 5 s with one open-APPEND-write-close cycle; never rewritten in place; readers take the last complete row
writer.on_failure: any short or failed write (chunk, commit line, heartbeat row, session.json) stops the session with end_reason script_error:write_fail; status ok is never written
writer.readers: read committed chunks only; discard uncommitted tails; C34 re-reads every committed chunk

decision.decide_in: EOnPostSimulate of the decision step P_t (P_t mod physics_steps_per_decision == 0), after the ctl and telemetry rows of P_t are written, from the state after step P_t
decision.applies_in: EOnSimulate of steps P_t + 1 .. P_t + physics_steps_per_decision
decision.bridge_pause: the closed-loop bridge (DD-8) pauses after EOnPostSimulate of P_t, sends state_t and obs_t, and applies the returned command from step P_t + 1

obs.rule: the newest image whose captured hf frame has last_physics_step <= P_t

joins.hf_to_telemetry: as-of: the newest telemetry.physics_step <= hf.last_physics_step; its age is below telemetry_every_k steps when no telemetry row is missing, otherwise the frame is not joined (masks 0)
joins.capture_pose: hf.cam_* and hf.veh_* of the captured frame

image_grid.anchor: world_time_ms of physics_step 0 (the first decision step)
image_grid.due_ms: anchor + g * 1000 / image_hz - clocks.img_lead_ms for grid point g = 0, 1, 2, ...; each grid point reached while the ego is live and the camera current becomes the next slot_id
image_grid.issue: the first render frame whose world time is at or past due_ms; one request in flight
image_grid.in_flight_timeout: a request whose file is not seen within clocks.img_inflight_timeout_ms (real time) stops blocking the next slot: events kind img_timeout (payload img_slot_id=<n>) and heartbeat img_fail
image_grid.session_end: no new request; hf rows continue until no request is in flight or img_inflight_timeout_ms has passed, then the session seals; requests still unresolved count as images.pending_at_end

types.float: decimal number with '.', no exponent, finite (no NaN/inf, C05)

fields.name: physics_step
fields.desc: Own physics-step counter: -1 when the session opens, +1 at the top of EOnSimulate, so the first step is 0. The row is written in EOnPostSimulate of the same step.

fields.name: world_time_ms
fields.desc: World time since the session start: WorldTimestamp.DiffMilliseconds against the session-start timestamp (R03). Non-decreasing.

fields.name: episode_id
fields.desc: Current episode; -1 outside an episode (warm-up, settle, between episodes).

fields.name: mode
fields.desc: Capture mode of this step (r2 3.1): E clean expert, N noise injection, R recovery start, X exploration, D DAgger, H human, A AI ego, I idle (no HL command held: warm-up, settle).

fields.name: driver
fields.desc: Who produced the executed HL command of this step (C18, C27).

fields.name: hl_seq
fields.desc: Counter of the HL decision applied in this step: -1 before the first decision; it increments on the first step after each decision step (physics_step mod physics_steps_per_decision == 1), because the decision of P_t is taken in EOnPostSimulate of P_t and applies from step P_t + 1 (section 6, TBD-1).

fields.name: hl_kappa
fields.desc: Held HL curvature target applied in this step's EOnSimulate (the action_cmd.kappa_target of decision hl_seq, decided at the previous decision step), right-positive. Empty in mode I.

fields.name: hl_accel
fields.desc: Held HL acceleration target applied in this step (action_cmd.a_target, desired).

fields.name: hl_dir
fields.desc: Held HL direction command applied in this step: -1 reverse, 0 stop, +1 forward.

fields.name: exp_kappa_now
fields.desc: Expert HL curvature re-evaluated on the true state after this step (EOnPostSimulate, r2 3.2): a 60 Hz diagnostic; at a decision step P_t it is the label of decision t, which in mode E is the command applied from P_t + 1. Empty when no expert is attached.

fields.name: exp_accel_now
fields.desc: Expert HL acceleration re-evaluated after this step.

fields.name: exp_dir_now
fields.desc: Expert HL direction re-evaluated after this step (added to r2's exp_{kappa,accel}_now so the label has all three action channels).

fields.name: llc_steer_raw

fields.name: llc_steer_lim

fields.name: llc_throttle

fields.name: slot_id

fields.name: issue_physics_step

fields.name: cam_current
fields.desc: 1 when the rig camera is the current camera at issue (C18).

fields.name: cam_attached
fields.desc: 1 when the rig camera is attached to the ego at issue (C18).

fields.name: event_seq
fields.desc: Event counter, 0-based, +1 per row.

fields.name: episode_id

fields.name: world_time_ms

fields.name: style_speed_factor

fields.name: style_alat_max_mps2

fields.name: env_weather_state

fields.name: env_tod_h_start

fields.name: env_rain

fields.name: env_fog
fields.desc: Fog at the episode start.

fields.name: env_wetness
fields.desc: Wetness at the episode start.

fields.name: seed

fields.name: expert_sha

fields.name: roughness_sensitivity

fields.name: veh_dirt_body

fields.name: veh_dirt_glass
fields.desc: Reserved, null on 1.8 (MIGRATION_1_9 8.3).

fields.name: slot_id
fields.desc: img.slot_id.

fields.name: png_w
fields.desc: Image width (C11: exactly 1408 for the client class).

fields.name: png_h
fields.desc: Image height (C11: exactly 720 for the client class).

fields.name: fid_ok
fields.desc: 1 when fiducial v2 decodes in both bands and they agree (C13a).

fields.name: captured_render_frame
fields.desc: Decoded render_frame mod 2^18 unwrapped against issue_render_frame; joins hf (r2 3.3: completion and captured_render_frame come from the fiducial).

fields.name: fid_margin
fields.desc: Smallest nearest-colour margin over the decoded patches.

fields.name: deriv_path
fields.desc: 512x288 JPEG q95 derivative path, once built.

fields.name: physics_step
fields.desc: ctl.physics_step.

fields.name: steer_cmd
fields.desc: steer_sign * llc_steer_lim: commanded steering in the contract sign (right-positive).

fields.name: steer_input
fields.desc: steer_sign * input_post_steer: steering input readback in the contract sign.

fields.name: physics_step
fields.desc: telemetry.physics_step.

fields.name: heading_rad
fields.desc: atan2(fwd_x, fwd_z): 0 = north (+z), positive clockwise seen from above. World frame, eval_only.

fields.name: speed_fwd_mps
fields.desc: vel_local_z: signed forward speed (negative in reverse).

fields.name: yaw_rate_rps
fields.desc: yaw_axis_sign * angvel_local_y, right-positive (TBD-5).

fields.name: acc_long_mps2
fields.desc: acc_local_z: achieved longitudinal acceleration.

fields.name: acc_lat_mps2
fields.desc: acc_local_x: achieved lateral acceleration, right-positive.

fields.name: kappa_realised
fields.desc: yaw_rate_rps / speed_fwd_mps when abs(speed_fwd_mps) > 3 m/s, else empty.

fields.name: dir_state
fields.desc: Drive direction from the gear through the vehicle card: +1 forward gear, 0 neutral, -1 reverse (TBD-7); forward-only in T0-MIN (section 7).

fields.name: delta_eff_rad
fields.desc: Reserved: bicycle-equivalent road-wheel angle from wheel_angle_l/r; C15's steer_eff once it exists. kappa = tan(delta_eff)/L holds only for abs(a_lat) <= 1 m/s2 [target].

nav.per: telemetry row in an episode with a route

fields.name: p10_y

fields.name: p20_x

fields.name: p20_y

fields.name: p40_y

fields.name: man_straight

fields.name: man_right

fields.name: physics_step
fields.desc: telemetry.physics_step.
